item.title: [2023-02] I'm glad to annouce that I'm joining University of Texas at Austin as an Aerospace Engineering Ph.D. student in 2023 Fall. See you in Austin, TX!
item.description: I’m glad to announce that I will join UT Austin as a Ph.D. student in 2023 Fall. I’m going to work as a research assistant in CLeAR Lab, under supervison of Prof. David Fridovich-Keil. My reseach focus includes reinforcement learning, game theory, social navigation and SLAM.
